title: Küçük iyilik

characters.MAN: a young man with short blond hair, wearing a dark green parka and a beige scarf
characters.OLDLADY: an elderly woman with short silver hair and a purple knitted hat, wearing a long plum coat
characters.CHILD: her granddaughter, a little girl of about eight with a black ponytail, wearing a pink coat

scenes.text: Bir sabah otobüste yaşlı bir teyzeye yer verdin.
scenes.prompt: On a city bus on a cold winter morning, {MAN} stands up from his seat and gestures kindly for {OLDLADY} to sit down, she smiles gratefully.

scenes.text:
Belki iki dakika sürdü,
belki unuttun bile.
scenes.prompt: {MAN} steps off the bus onto a snowy street and walks away with his hands in his pockets, the bus driving off, soft winter light.

scenes.text: Ama o akşam torununa seni anlattı.
scenes.prompt: In a warm living room in the evening, {OLDLADY} sits on a sofa telling a story to {CHILD}, who listens wide-eyed, a lamp and steaming cups of tea.

scenes.text: Torunu da ertesi gün birine yardım etti.
scenes.prompt: In a snowy schoolyard, {CHILD} kneels and helps a small boy pick up his scattered colored pencils from the snow, both smiling.

scenes.text:
İyilik küçüktür
ama yolculuğu hiç bitmez.
scenes.prompt: A snowy town street at dusk with warm glowing windows, {MAN} walks past and smiles as {CHILD} waves at him from across the street, snow falling gently.

caption:
Yaptığın küçük bir iyilik, bilmediğin bir yerde yaşamaya devam eder. 🤍

Bugün kime bir iyilik yapacaksın?
